title: Flow Wire Snap Compatible Ports
description: Add snapping between compatible inputs and outputs while dragging connection preview wires in flow.
summary: While dragging a connection wire, the graph engine now snaps to the nearest compatible free handle within a zoom-aware tolerance. `DrawEdge` tracks `snap_target`; preview beziers terminate at the snapped port; release connects when still inside the snap halo. Snapping respects `is_valid_connection` (role, occupancy, acyclicity).
